summary: Inventories can be INI or YAML; INI suits a few hosts, YAML scales better, and YAML can give hosts unique names with ansible_host set to the address.
questions: Should I use INI or YAML for my inventory?
How do I write an Ansible inventory in YAML?

answer_card.title: YAML inventory example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
myhosts:
  hosts:
    my_host_01:
      ansible_host: 192.0.2.50
    my_host_02:
      ansible_host: 192.0.2.51
```
INI is simplest for a few hosts; YAML is easier as the number of hosts grows.
